sloka: विकर्षन्नूर्मिजालानि बृहन्ति लवणाम्भसि ।पुप्लुवे कपिशार्दूलो विकिरन्निव रोदसी ॥५-१-७१॥
transliteration: vikarṣannūrmijālāni bṛhanti lavaṇāmbhasi ।pupluve kapiśārdūlo vikiranniva rodasī ॥5-1-71॥

translations.english: As the tiger among the monkeys pushed the big network of waves of the saltwater ocean and leaped forward, it appeared as if he was drawing the intermediary space dividing the earth and the sky.
